# SEOptimer

SEOptimer provides asynchronous website SEO audits with detailed check results and optional branded PDF reports.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/seoptimer/.

## Actions

- **Create Audit Report**: Submit one website for an asynchronous SEO audit.
- **Get Audit Report** (read-only): Return the current state of an SEO audit report by ID.
